crossRefs.note: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Yahweh, these…
These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes…
The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had…
The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe…

parallels.note: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

translations.web: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
translations.bsb: Now these were the territories assigned to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clan for their settlements, because the first lot fell to them:
translations.kjv: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
translations.asv: Now these are their dwelling-places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
